faq.q: Which areas and property types does the page say Jared covers?
faq.a: Areas named on the page: South Surrey, Langley, White Rock, Surrey, Brookswood, Cloverdale, Ladner, Tsawwassen and communities across the Fraser Valley. Property types named: condos, townhomes, detached homes, acreages, farms, land and mobile homes, across residential, rural and investment properties — all as the page states them.

faq.q: How do I contact Jared from this page?
faq.a: Through the site footer carried on the page: a "Contact Me" link, office and cell phone both shown as 604-928-1361, the email address shown in the footer block, and the office address #201, 15272 Croydon Drive, Surrey, BC, V3Z 0Z5. The page body has no contact form of its own.

faq.q: Which areas does Jared Gibbons serve?
faq.a: Jared works across South Surrey, White Rock and Langley, and more broadly the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver, including Surrey, Cloverdale, Delta, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Mission and Maple Ridge. Call or text 604-928-1361.

faq.q: How long has Jared been a REALTOR®?
faq.a: Jared has been a licensed REALTOR® since 2015 and is with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty.
